本研究复用公开预训练权重与既有基线结果，部分运行涉及不同GPU硬件，参数敏感性结果因此反映当前实验条件下的经验变化，不作为完全硬件受控的单因素因果估计。评估套件在方法开发中被重复使用，公开预训练权重的完整数据来源尚未独立闭合核验；这些结果属于开发阶段证据，而非独立留出集上的最终确认。

终身机器人模仿学习需要在有限记忆下持续获得新技能并保留旧技能。仅回放专家示范，难以直接约束策略在自主成功执行状态上的行为变化。本文提出双经验行为保持框架DEBR，协同利用专家示范与策略自主成功经验。随机锚定核心集RA-Coreset在覆盖导向选择中引入受保护的随机锚点，通过固定配额下的覆盖感知交换组织示范记忆；成功历史行为保持SHBR缓存成功执行时的潜在历史及固定高斯行为参考，并依据成功轨迹支持度调节保持强度。为协调保持与新任务学习，候选更新门控从相同训练状态比较基础学习与保持增强两类更新，仅在当前任务拟合不劣且旧历史保持更优时接受增强候选。在LIBERO-OBJECT与LIBERO-GOAL上的三个随机种子实验中，DEBR的AUC分别达到86.5%和87.3%，相对本地MLR＋IFA复现提高18.2和10.9个百分点。选样与组件消融、优化器预算匹配及保持系数分析共同支持双经验利用与更新选择的价值。新增记忆与候选比较均用于训练，部署时保持原策略推理结构不变。
关键词：终身模仿学习；机器人操作；经验回放；核心集选择；行为保持

Lifelong robot imitation learning requires acquiring new skills while retaining previous ones under a limited memory budget. Replaying expert demonstrations alone does not directly constrain behavioral changes on states encountered during successful autonomous execution. We propose DEBR, a dual-experience behavioral retention framework that combines expert demonstrations with the policy’s own successful experience. Random-anchored coreset selection (RA-Coreset) organizes demonstration memory by incorporating protected random anchors into a coverage-oriented subset through fixed-budget, coverage-aware exchanges. Successful Historical Behavior Retention (SHBR) stores latent histories and fixed Gaussian behavior references from successful execution, and calibrates retention strength using trajectory-level support. To coordinate retention with new-task learning, a candidate-update gate compares base and retention-augmented updates from the same training state. It accepts the augmented candidate only when current-task fitting is no worse and historical retention is better on fixed training probes. Across three seeds on LIBERO-OBJECT and LIBERO-GOAL, DEBR achieves AUC scores of 86.5% and 87.3%, improving over our local MLR+IFA reproduction by 18.2 and 10.9 percentage points, respectively. Selection and component ablations, optimizer-budget matching, and retention-weight sensitivity analysis support the value of combining dual experience with update selection. The added memory and candidate comparison are confined to training, leaving the policy inference architecture unchanged.
Keywords: Lifelong imitation learning; Robot manipulation; Experience replay; Coreset selection; Behavioral retention
